description: The Blue Heart project publishes high-density flood and sewer monitoring from an approximately seventy-eight-square-kilometre catchment in the United Kingdom. Zenodo provides an index CSV, six sensor archives, network and catchment shapefiles, and a README free under CC BY 4.0. The index maps 497 gauges to type, location, timeseries path, parameters, units and quality-flag files. Instruments cover rain, rivers, boreholes, highway gullies and sewer levels; contextual air and water temperatures are also included. These data can calibrate coupled surface-water, groundwater and drainage simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this catchment. The project and Southern Water supplied data under an explicit sharing permission. Range, change-rate and persistence flags identify suspect values, which should not be ignored. Exact observation periods and completeness vary by sensor. No archive was downloaded, quality flag recomputed or flood model run.
